messages:
Ivy (CS): Heads-up 2VelocityFleet2 usage dropped ~67% over 9 days. Seat pings and scheduled jobs failing. New procurement lead Lena Park started this week; CTO mentioned a side-by-side with TurboServe. Renewal ~32 days. Can we triage quick?

Marco (Solutions): Looking now. Any 4xx/5xx spikes or webhook failures? looping in @Omar.

Omar (Eng): Saw clustered 401s and a 410 on billing webhook for org=55123 on 2025-09-12. Proxy snippet: `{"org":"55123","status":401,"path":"/v1/chat","err":"invalid_token"}`. 410 on billing webhook may disable features.

Priya (Sales): Renewal in ~32 days. If CTO is testing TurboServe we need to (1) restore traffic immediately and (2) offer a short perf window to stall vendor momentum. I'll prepare commercial terms.

Ivy (CS): Immediate playbook:
- Outreach: quick async note to Lena offering a 30-min triage call today (Marco + Omar).
- Tech: confirm token/webhook secret; Omar to rotate token and requeue failed webhook deliveries.
- Commercial: offer a 7-day dedicated perf trial (complimentary) while we monitor telemetry; Priya to draft PO.
- CRM: tag reasons ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_eval"] and mark renewal_flag=at-risk until QBR.

Support Bot: Ticket VF-900 created 5VelocityFleet: invalid_token + billing webhook 410 - renewal-risk6 https://support.redwood/vf/900

Omar (Eng): Rotating token now and re-sending webhook deliveries. ETA ~15m. Will add a temporary rate-limit bump to avoid retry storms.

Marco (Solutions): Sending Lena a short checklist: confirm token in env matches console, update SDK to >=1.5.2, run a sample request below and paste the response.

Priya (Sales): Drafting trial terms: "7-day dedicated perf trial, telemetry review, complimentary credits" and routing to Legal for fast-track.

Ivy (CS): Please update this thread when VF-900 is resolved and when the trial PO is issued. I'll prepare an exec summary for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
